content.text: Summary: Read T-4005, inspected shop-web pods and storefront-web logs, and found the 3.0 container is listening on port 3000 while pods are Ready via a direct healthz probe — a classic Service targetPort/containerPort mismatch causing ingress-nginx 502s. Resolved the ticket with the cause, evidence, and a fix (update the Service targetPort to 3000, ideally via a named port) citing the Kubernetes debugging and Service port docs. No rollback of 3.0 is needed.
